portfolio-lifecycle: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO phases (phase_code, project_code, phase_number, name, description, status) SELECT 'P1-'||p.project_code, p.project_code, 1, 'Operate and verify', 'auto (PORTFOLIO-LIFECYCLE-1): the project had no phase, so v_project_health could not report progress. Done when its owning worker answers /health and its newest linked deploy is younger than 30 days.', CASE WHEN p.status='completed' THEN 'completed' ELSE 'in_progress' END FROM projects p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM phases ph WHERE ph.project_code=p.project_code)"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO project_ledger (project_id, session_id, phase, task_id, action, evidence, worker_name, timestamp) SELECT p.project_code, 'portfolio-lifecycle', COALESCE((SELECT MAX(ph.phase_number) FROM phases ph WHERE ph.project_code=p.project_code),1), 'deploy:'||dh.id, 'deployed', 'version '||COALESCE(dh.version_id,'?')||' deployed by '||COALESCE(dh.deployed_by,'?'), dh.resource_name, COALESCE(dh.deployed_at, datetime('now')) FROM deployment_history dh JOIN projects p ON p.project_code='W.'||dh.resource_name WHERE dh.action IN ('deploy','deployed') AND COALESCE(dh.status,'success')='success' AND replace(substr(COALESCE(dh.deployed_at,''),1,19),'T',' ') >= datetime('now','-7 days') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_ledger l WHERE l.task_id='deploy:'||dh.id) ORDER BY dh.id DESC LIMIT 400"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO project_state (project_code, session_id, current_phase, phase_progress, resource_counts, git_commit) SELECT l.project_id, l.task_id, l.phase, 1.0, json_object('worker', dh.resource_name, 'version', dh.version_id, 'deployed_at', dh.deployed_at, 'deployed_by', dh.deployed_by), NULL FROM project_ledger l JOIN deployment_history dh ON l.task_id='deploy:'||dh.id WHERE l.action='deployed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_state s WHERE s.project_code=l.project_id AND s.session_id=l.task_id) ORDER BY l.id ASC LIMIT 400"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE projects SET updated_at = (SELECT MAX(replace(substr(dh.deployed_at,1,19),'T',' ')) FROM deployment_history dh WHERE dh.resource_name=projects.owner_service AND dh.action='deploy' AND COALESCE(dh.status,'success')='success') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deployment_history dh WHERE dh.resource_name=projects.owner_service AND dh.action='deploy' AND COALESCE(dh.status,'success')='success' AND replace(substr(dh.deployed_at,1,19),'T',' ') > COALESCE(projects.updated_at,''))"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE programs SET updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE program_code IN (SELECT DISTINCT program_code FROM projects WHERE updated_at >= datetime('now','-1 day'))"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO portfolio_gaps (kind, entity, detail, day) SELECT 'project-stale-deploy', p.project_code, 'active project whose owner last deployed '||COALESCE((SELECT MAX(dh.deployed_at) FROM deployment_history dh WHERE dh.resource_name=p.owner_service AND dh.action IN ('deploy','deployed') AND COALESCE(dh.status,'success')='success'),'never'), date('now') FROM projects p WHERE p.status='active' AND p.owner_service IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE((SELECT MAX(replace(substr(dh.deployed_at,1,19),'T',' ')) FROM deployment_history dh WHERE dh.resource_name=p.owner_service AND dh.action IN ('deploy','deployed') AND COALESCE(dh.status,'success')='success'),'1970-01-01') < datetime('now','-30 days')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO portfolio_gaps (kind, entity, detail, day) SELECT 'deploy-unrecorded', s.service, 'live worker '||s.service||' has no successful deploy in deployment_history, so its project cannot show what it runs', date('now') FROM service_registry s WHERE s.kind='worker' AND s.state='live' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deployment_history dh WHERE dh.resource_name=s.service AND dh.action IN ('deploy','deployed') AND COALESCE(dh.status,'success')='success')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cloud_ops_events (id, ts, kind, text, meta, job, status) SELECT 'portfolio-lifecycle-'||strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S','now'), datetime('now'), 'portfolio-lifecycle', 'PORTFOLIO-LIFECYCLE-1: '||(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_ledger WHERE action='deployed')||' linked deploys over ' ||(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) FROM project_ledger WHERE action='deployed')||' projects | ' ||(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE status='active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM phases ph WHERE ph.project_code=projects.project_code))||' active projects without a phase | ' ||(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues WHERE source='portfolio-lifecycle' AND status='open')||' open portfolio issues', NULL, 'portfolio-lifecycle', 'ok'"}]}
portfolio-deploy-sync: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO project_deployment_state (project_code, worker_name, deployments, first_deploy, last_deploy, last_version, versions, last_upgrade, days_since_deploy, synced_at) SELECT p.project_code, d.resource_name, COUNT(*), MIN(d.deployed_at), MAX(d.deployed_at), (SELECT d2.version_id FROM deployment_history d2 WHERE d2.resource_name = d.resource_name AND d2.version_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d2.deployed_at DESC LIMIT 1), COUNT(DISTINCT d.version_id), NULL, CAST(julianday('now') - julianday(MAX(d.deployed_at)) AS INTEGER), datetime('now') FROM projects p JOIN deployment_history d ON d.resource_name = p.owner_service WHERE true GROUP BY p.project_code, d.resource_name ON CONFLICT(project_code, worker_name) DO UPDATE SET deployments = excluded.deployments, first_deploy = excluded.first_deploy, last_deploy = excluded.last_deploy, last_version = excluded.last_version, last_upgrade = CASE WHEN project_deployment_state.last_version IS NOT excluded.last_version THEN datetime('now') ELSE project_deployment_state.last_upgrade END, versions = excluded.versions, days_since_deploy = excluded.days_since_deploy, synced_at = excluded.synced_at"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO portfolio_gaps (kind, entity, detail, day, status) SELECT kind, ref, detail, date('now'), 'open' FROM v_portfolio_deploy_drift"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE portfolio_gaps SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = datetime('now') WHERE status = 'open' AND kind IN ('project-never-deployed','project-deploy-stale','project-no-upgrade-tracked') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_portfolio_deploy_drift v WHERE v.kind = portfolio_gaps.kind AND v.ref = portfolio_gaps.entity)"}]}
